The P/E ratio of 54.1x [E1] and a Price-to-Book ratio of 9.30x [E2] are notably higher than the sector benchmarks, indicating that the stock is trading at a premium relative to its peers. Furthermore, the DCF analysis shows an intrinsic value of Rs 959 per share against the current market price of Rs 2120 [E45], resulting in a margin of safety of -121% [E70]. This suggests that the stock is overvalued by a substantial margin. Conceded: [E8] The company does outperform its sector on metrics like Return on Assets (ROA), but this alone does not justify the current valuation given the significant overvaluation indicated by DCF and P/E ratios.
